writeup: Woot has the limited-edition Wrangler x Stranger Things 13MWZ jean in Wrangler Blue, size 33W x 34L, new for $15.99. Walmart sells the same style (112376179) for $42.17, so this is about 62% less, a $26 saving. The pockets are lined with a Hawkins patchwork print, and Woot caps it at 10 per customer.
